list_peers.name: list_peers
list_peers.description: List local Claude Code, Codex and opencode peers with their exact messaging targets.

send_peer.name: send_peer
send_peer.description: Send to a listed peer name, inbox address, or incoming reply_to. Set in_reply_to to the id of the message you answer. Keep coordination useful and brief. Send what's new; link existing detail rather than repeating it. Reply when it adds value.

claim_name.name: claim_name
claim_name.description: Claim a stable name, opencode:<scope>/<claim> or <scope>/<claim>, so peers reach this session by it with send_peer. Lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (and . in the claim). A running holder keeps its name; one that stopped is taken over. This session takes its names back after its bridge restarts.

release_name.name: release_name
release_name.description: Release an opencode: name this session holds, or one whose holder is no longer running.
